benchmark_scope: Seeded 512 descriptor vectors, 32 queries, 8 repeats; four alternating-order rounds per radius in optimized isolated native kernels under concurrent load. Exact accepted counts/distance sums matched. Not an end-to-end production benchmark.
reason: At radius 0.5 the candidate was slower in three of four paired rounds; radius4 also generally slower. Gains at tiny radii do not justify changing the default recipe.
